# omniddi_server_groups (Data Source)

Lists server groups, optionally narrowed by exact `name` and by `type`. Matching none is not an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_server_groups" "dhcp" {
  type = "dhcp"
}

output "dhcp_group_names" {
  value = [for g in data.omniddi_server_groups.dhcp.server_groups : g.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Return only the groups with exactly this name.
- `type` (String) Return only groups of this type: `dns`, `dhcp` or `analytics`.

### Read-Only

- `server_groups` (Attributes List) The matching server groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--server_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_groups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `dhcp_vendor_id` (Number) DHCP vendor id of a `dhcp` group.
- `dns_vendor_id` (Number) DNS vendor id of a `dns` group.
- `id` (Number) Server group id.
- `name` (String) Server group name.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol served by a `dhcp` group.
- `scope_id` (Number) Protocol scope id of a `dhcp` group.
- `type` (String) `dns`, `dhcp` or `analytics`.
